diagram_previews.alt: Case 1: triangle ABC above the horizontal side BC and its mirror image A''BC below. The dashed segment AA'' crosses BC at a point X between B and C. Single ticks mark BA = BA'' and double ticks mark CA = CA''.
Case 2: triangle ABC with a right angle at B and its mirror image A''BC below. A, B and A'' lie on one vertical line, so AA'' meets BC at B. Ticks mark BA = BA'' and CA = CA''.
Case 3: triangle ABC with an obtuse angle at B and its mirror image A''BC below. The dashed segment AA'' meets the extension of CB beyond B at X. Ticks mark BA = BA'' and CA = CA''.
